item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #MINPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 16 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(ManoloFortich, ImpasugOng, Baungon, Libona, Pangantucan, Maramag, Lantapan, CityOfValencia, CityOfMalaybalay), #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfPanabo, Carmen, CityOfTagum), #DavaoDeOro(Mabini, Maco, Pantukan), #DavaoCity, #MisamisOccidental(OroquietaCity, Plaridel, LopezJaena, Aloran, Panaon, Jimenez), #AgusanDelSur(LaPaz), #MisamisOriental(Balingasag, Jasaan, Claveria, Tagoloan, Villanueva, Initao, Naawan, Manticao, Libertad, Gitagum, Laguindingan and Alubijid) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Bukidnon(Sumilao, Malitbog) and #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfSamal) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
